Growing up happens fast. One day a little one is riding home from the hospital and before long, they’ve outgrown their infant car seat. That’s exactly why Target offers Car Seat Trade-In: to make it easy for families to recycle an old car seat while saving on what’s next.

Now in its 10th year, the event returns September 20 through October 3, 2026, guests can bring any old car seat to a participating Target store and receive a 20% Target Circle bonus to use on new baby gear.
